_readme: Head motion and avatar sync, versioned. Edited from /tune (live sliders) or by hand. The dashboard writes this file and mirrors it to /dev/shm/cj_motion.json, which is what the robot's breath loop reads every cycle (app/main_voice_robot.py _motion). Before 2026-09-14 the ONLY copy was the /dev/shm one, so every setting was lost on reboot; this file is why they now survive. avatar_lag (the browser's audio-vs-animation lag, /dev/shm/cj_avatar_lag) is carried here too since 2026-09-14: it had the same shape as the motion knobs — set from /maintain, stored only on tmpfs, silently back to a hardcoded 0.8 on the next cold boot. Values are clamped to the ranges in ui_common.MOTION_KNOBS on write, so a hand-edited out-of-range number is corrected rather than obeyed.
_target: A composed man in his late eighties who spent a career being still in a courtroom. Small deliberate shifts, nothing that snaps, and a breath that is visible at two metres without anyone consciously noticing it. If it reads as motion, it is too much.

composed._note: The default since 2026-09-14. Sway cut from 4.0 deg to 1.6 and slowed; voice emphasis nearly halved; breathing given a real rate so stillness reads as alive rather than frozen.

livelier._note: Closer to the pre-2026-09-14 behaviour. For a big room where small movement disappears, or for a camera that flattens motion.

still._note: Lowest motion that is still alive. Breathing only, no sway, no voice emphasis. Use this to check that the head never reads as a frozen frame.

_sync_offsets._note: avatar_offset in seconds, per audio route: how long after play_ts the sound actually reaches a listener, which is how far the browser animation must be DELAYED to match (+later, -earlier). They differ because the path from the app to the air differs. Measure by playing a 40 ms 1 kHz burst through the live route and recording it on a microphone the robot does not hold, anchoring to the END of a fixed-length capture (arecord's start time is not knowable; its duration is sample-exact). Then trim by ear on /tune while the robot speaks. UNMEASURED entries are honest placeholders — do not extrapolate one route from another.

internal.method: 40 ms 1 kHz burst through the internal speaker (XMOS), captured on the BOYA mini 2 (card 2, a mic the robot does not hold), matched-filter onset, anchored to the end of a 3 s arecord capture
internal.caveat: UPPER BOUND. Both error sources are positive — arecord teardown and the BOYA's own capture latency — so true play-to-air is <= 348 ms. Use 0.35 s as a starting point and trim by ear; the slider exists for the remainder.
internal.cross_check: CJ_AEC_REF_DELAY_MS=444 in the systemd drop-in is the separately calibrated delay for the same route through the XVF's own mic path, which is longer. The two are consistent.

_sync_offsets.dac: UNMEASURED — no USB DAC is attached. Do not extrapolate from internal.
_sync_offsets.bluetooth: UNMEASURED — do not extrapolate from internal.
